interleave_datasets_equal: interleave multiple datasets by cycling through each source to alternate examples evenly
interleave_datasets_probabilities: interleave datasets using weighted probabilities to sample examples from each source randomly
interleave_datasets_stopping_strategy: interleave datasets with stopping strategy all_exhausted to include every sample from all sources
concatenate_datasets_vertical: concatenate multiple datasets vertically along rows to stack them end to end
concatenate_datasets_horizontal: concatenate multiple datasets horizontally along columns to join them side by side
